_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Mapaich gach litir gu digit aon-neach gus an arithmetic a chumail.
Cuir sònrachadh le `[A 5]`, ath-shònrachadh aig àm sam bith.

invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Litir {letter} nach eil ann an puzzle.
invalid_move.digit_used: Digit {digit} air a chleachdadh mu thràth le {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Chan urrainn do dhìogal ceannasach facal a bhith 0.

outcome.correct: Ceart! Tha an co-ionannachd air a shàsachadh.
outcome.incorrect: Tha a' mhapachadh air crìochnachadh ach chan eil an co-ionannachd ceart.
